kurz: Cook vacuum-sealed meat or fish in a water bath precisely to the target temperature. Even from edge to edge, then seared briefly.
bild_im_kopf: Like a thermostat instead of a campfire.
was_passiert: The water is exactly as warm as the desired [[kerntemperatur|core temperature]]. So the food cannot overcook, only take longer. Afterwards it needs a very hot pan for the crust.
schritte: Season the meat and vacuum-seal it.
Bring the water bath to the target temperature, e.g. 55 °C for pink beef (as a guide).
Cook for 1–3 hours depending on thickness.
Take it out and pat it dry.
Sear in a very hot pan for 1 minute per side.
